text:
Hi Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to set up our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my calendar, I have these free half-hour windows inside working hours:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Wednesday 10:00-10:30
- Wednesday 13:00-13:30
- Wednesday 15:00-15:30

Would any of those work for you? I'll book the first one that suits and put it on my calendar.

Best,
John
Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to set up our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Do you have a slot that works for you, or shall I propose one from my calendar?

Hi John,

All five of those work for me, so let's take the first: Monday 10:00-10:30. I've booked it on my calendar.

Best,
Professor Alvarez

Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to set up our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Would Monday 10:00–10:30 work for you? If not, I have Tuesday 15:40–17:00, Wednesday 11:50–13:00 (except 13:00 start), or Thursday 12:50–14:20 open-ish. Let me know what suits you and I'll put it on my calendar.

Hi Sarah,

No need — I have a slot for you: Tuesday 15:00-15:30 next week. I've booked it on my side; please put it on yours.

Best,
Professor Alvarez

Booked — Monday 10:00-10:30 on my calendar too. See you then, and thanks for the quick reply.

Best,
John

Hi Priya,

Sorry — Monday 10:00-10:30 I've just given to John, and the other windows you listed collide with my standing commitments (Tuesday 15:30-17:00, Wednesday 11:40-13:00, Thursday 12:50-14:20).

Two options of mine that are free: Monday 14:00-14:30 or Thursday 10:00-10:30. Tell me which you prefer and I'll book it.

Best,
Professor Alvarez
Perfect — see you Monday at 10:00. Have a good weekend.
Thanks, you too — see you Monday.
Thanks! Tuesday 15:00-15:30 next week is on my calendar. See you then.

Perfect — let's take Monday 14:00-14:30. I've booked it on my calendar.

Best,
Priya

Done — Monday 14:00-14:30 is booked on my calendar. See you then.

Professor Alvarez
